_readme: Published reference prices used by the tests. Every value must come from a source you can cite.
Entries with status 'TODO' have null expected values and are skipped until you fill them in from a textbook.
'decimals' is how many decimal places the source prints; the test tolerance is half a unit in that place.
Inputs follow docs/conventions.md: rate and div_yield continuously compounded, vol and rates as decimals, expiry in years.

black_scholes.source: Hull, Options, Futures, and Other Derivatives: worked Black-Scholes-Merton example (S=42, K=40, r=10%, sigma=20%, T=6 months). Example number differs by edition.
